nodes.bdb: Harbona or Harbonah = "ass-driver" the 3rd of the seven chamberlains or eunuchs who served Ahasuerus

nodes.g: Zethar = "star" one of the seven eunuchs of Ahasuerus
Ahasuerus = "I will be silent and poor" title of the king of Persia, probably Xerxes
Bigtha = "in the wine-press" a eunuch in king Ahasuerus' (Xerxes) court
Abagtha = "God-given" one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus
Carcas = "severe" the 7th of the 7 eunuchs of king Ahasuerus
Mehuman = "faithful" one of the 7 eunuchs of Ahasuerus
